title: Rap Sta Bam #001 — Tzimos
excerpt: In the inaugural episode, Tzimos enters the session with no prepared tracks, crafting a beat, lyrics, recording, and a final performance live on camera.
description: In every episode of Rap Sta Bam, a guest rapper joins us in the studio from complete scratch.
We start from zero: building a beat together, writing live bars, testing ideas, making mistakes, capturing raw moments on digital film, and documenting the entire process down to the final cut.
In our premiere episode, we are joined by Tzimos from Heraklion, Crete.
We dive into his music, inspirations, artistic process, and everything that unfolds behind the scenes before a track reaches its finished form.
If you want to see how songs are forged from scratch, subscribe to Rap Sta Bam and join us for upcoming sessions.
Every episode: a new artist, a new concept, a fresh track.

title: Rap Sta Bam #002 — Nesom
excerpt: In session two, Nesom steps into the studio. We discuss his musical influences and the spontaneous creative process before a track takes its final shape.
description: On Rap Sta Bam, guest rappers pull up to the studio with zero pre-written verses.
We assemble the beat, write bars, iterate on flows, make mistakes, and capture the full journey through to the final bounce.
